description: Checks up to 10 EU EORI customs numbers (incl. XI) live in the European Commission's EOS validation service. Returns valid / not valid, and name and address where the holder agreed to publish them. GB EORI numbers are not supported.

eori_numbers.description: 1 to 10 EORI numbers with country code, e.g. DE1234567890123.

name: check_eori
title: Check EORI numbers
